bands.label: Easy buy / sweet spot
bands.reason: Choose a tasting sample before committing to an archival bottle.

bands.label: Fair buy
bands.reason: A purchase is conditional on bottle condition and a personally acceptable price.

bands.label: Think twice / conditional
bands.reason: Collectors may accept a premium for history; drinking Value remains unscored.

bands.label: Pass / trade up
bands.reason: Pass if the seller cannot establish the expression, closure condition and price context.

serving.name: Neat
serving.recommendation: Use a small neat archival sample if condition and provenance are sound.

serving.name: Rocks / water
serving.recommendation: Try dilution only after tasting; the corn varietal alone cannot predict the result.

serving.name: Old Fashioned
serving.recommendation: Do not infer mixing performance from producer notes; establish the actual sample’s flavor first.

serving.name: Manhattan
serving.recommendation: A historical grain comparison is more defensible than a claim that it performs like the modern blended Baby Jane.
